Privacy

Who is responsible

This is the personal website of Hasan Alizada, who is responsible for the data described here.

Analytics

If you press Accept in the cookie banner, the site loads Google Analytics 4 to count page views. It sets cookies, and Google processes this data under its own terms. If you press Decline, or make no choice, analytics does not load.

Your choice

Your choice is stored only in your browser, under the name ga-consent. You can change it at any time through the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page.

Email

If you write to me, I keep your message and address to reply and to keep a record of our conversation. I do not sell this data or use it for mailing lists.

Hosting

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may process technical data, such as IP addresses, to serve and protect the site.

Questions and requests

To ask what I hold about you, or to have it corrected or deleted, write to the address below.
